messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T08:14:00Z
Subject: OKR Signal Lens: Week of Nov 7 — Wins, Emerging Risks, and Two Asks for QBR

Folks,

Sending a compact signal lens for this week ahead of the QBR window. Two quick asks at the top — details and attachments below.

Top wins (week-over-week):
- Serving runtime: 12% improvement in median latency for seq len 512 on the A100 pool after kernel patch; SLOs currently meeting target in prod.
- Redwood Optimize pilot: initial quantization profiles reduced per-token cost by ~18% for high-throughput inference jobs (seen on three pilot customers).
- Sales -> Dedicated: Closed two renewals with upgraded reserved capacity commitment; tuck into QBR revenue slide.

Emergent risks / watchlist:
- Capacity mismatch: burst traffic in EU region flagged nightly throttles for a small set of dedicated tenants (root cause points to autoscale policy not firing for specific instance types). Risk: if not addressed, could impact 99th pctile latency for those tenants during peak.
- Eval regression: internal evals flagged subtle hallucination drift on one community model after a tokenizer change; product patch scheduled but needs validation.

Two asks for leadership before EOD Monday:
1) Review & sign off on the QBR Signal Packet (attached) — specifically the proposed "capacity mitigation" ask on slide 6. This is asking for approval to reassign 8 GPUs from burst pool to EU steady pool for the quarter.
2) Approve one dry-run slot for the QBR runbook on Nov 18 (30m) with SRE + CS present so we can validate fallbacks and incident playbooks.

Notes / attachments: attached QBR_signal_packet_v1.3.pdf (slide 6 = capacity ask), capacity_recommendation.xlsx (breakdown by customer / region). Also: draft deck in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BxyzQBR2026

If you want a 15m sync to walk through slides, I can do 9:30–10:00 PT Monday.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Operations Insights
Redwood Inference
